title: barista properties.json
description: Workspace execution preferences (<workspace>/.barista/properties.json); workspace level only; values must be scalars; unknown keys are ignored

jdk.description: JDK spec for this workspace (major like "17" or a jdk registry name; set by barista jdk use; overrides ~/.barista/maven.json and ~/.barista/gradle.json jdk)

maven.default.description: Workspace override of the default maven installation name (set by barista maven set-default --scope workspace; overrides ~/.barista/maven.json default)

gradle.default.description: Workspace override of the default gradle installation name (set by barista gradle set-default --scope workspace; overrides ~/.barista/gradle.json default)

gradle.user.home.description: Workspace-level gradle user home; barista gradle injects --gradle-user-home (relative paths anchor at the workspace root, ~ allowed)

maven.repo.local.description: Workspace-local maven repository; barista mvn injects -Dmaven.repo.local (relative paths anchor at the workspace root, ~ allowed)

maven.launch.description: How barista mvn starts Maven in this workspace: script (wrapper, default) or java (direct classworlds launch); overridden by --launch and repo properties

git.fetch.prune.description: Read by barista git fetch when --prune is not passed explicitly; run fetch with --prune

git.pull.rebase.description: Read by barista git pull when --rebase is not passed explicitly; run pull with --rebase
